Time to Buy VeriSign, Inc. (VRSN) After The Completion of This Double Top Chart Pattern?

The chart of VeriSign, Inc. (VRSN) shows a double top with $163.86 target or 5.00 % above today’s $156.06 share price. The 5 months chart pattern indicates low risk for the $18.87 billion company. It was reported on Dec, 1 by Finviz.com . If the $163.86 price target is reached, the company will be worth $943.30 million more. Double tops are rare but powerful chart patterns.

VeriSign, Inc. provides domain name registry services and Internet security worldwide. The company has market cap of $18.87 billion. The firm offers registry services that operate the authoritative directory of .com, .net, .cc, .tv, and .name domain names, as well as the back-end systems for .gov, .jobs, .edu, and other domain names. It has a 38.27 P/E ratio. The Company’s registry services allow individuals and organizations to establish their online identities.
